posts.author: KaiserDragon8
posts.body:
Greetings!
I couldn't find any answers to my question in already made threads, so I decided to start my own! I currently use MV, and make music for indie devs. I want to move up to Unite, since Unity is a diverse engine in and of itself. Unfortunately I don't have any firsthand knowledge on Unite and wanted to get some info from any Unite veterans! Specifically, since Unity has built in support for FMOD, to make diverse audio systems, does that support directly translate to the new RPG Maker Unite? Does Unite have better functionality to make more diverse audio and sound if FMOD isn't innately supported? On top of custom music, a full blown audio system takes a game to a new level, and if FMOD works with Unite that would make a world of difference to all devs using it. I'd buy Unite now, but it's just not in my budget at the moment. But if there's good audio support, it'll become a must buy for sure!
Thanks for any input and advice on Unite!
